criterion: Both source directions global mean/P95 improve; fixed-section chord/thickness absolute errors do not worsen beyond 1e-6 m and no section crossing. Same as existing evaluator; regions reported separately.
interpretation: Frozen output comparison only; these are not a full factorial experiment. The 26-step contour-ablation already uses the spline shape model and contour objective. Final V2 uses the same spline/contour method family with 100 steps, a smaller learning rate and finer render resolution. Differences between these frozen runs do not isolate the causal effect of one component. No subsequent tuning is allowed from these scores.
